items.title: 为 ChatGPT 构建插件

items.titleOriginal: Build Plugins for ChatGPT
items.descriptionOriginal: Explore plugin extensions through Meetings and OpenAI Developers. See how a custom interface can live beside a conversation and bring selected context into your work with ChatGPT.

items.title: 停止高薪情报 2026 DevDay
items.description: 在保持质量的同时削减人工智能成本。 学会测量每个已完成的任务的成本,选择模型和推理努力,并使用快速缓存、程序工具调用和批量API。
items.titleOriginal: Stop Overpaying for Intelligence | DevDay 2026
items.descriptionOriginal: Cut AI costs while preserving quality. Learn to measure cost per completed task, choose models and reasoning effort, and use prompt caching, Programmatic Tool Calling, and the Batch API.

items.title: 堆叠过度流 - 从思想到产品QQ DevDay 2026
items.description: 查看 Stack Overflow 的小团队如何使用 Codex 来构建 Stack Overflow for Agents 和 reimagine Stack 内部。 取下加速研发和将新产品带入市场的教训 。
items.titleOriginal: Stack Overflow - From Idea to Product | DevDay 2026
items.descriptionOriginal: See how small teams at Stack Overflow used Codex to build Stack Overflow for Agents and reimagine Stack Internal. Take away lessons for accelerating R&D and bringing new products to market.

items.title: Higgsfield - 建筑代理 提供自己的计算 QQ DevDay 2026
items.description: 探索Higgsfield代理如何选择模型并提供自己的计算。学习何时使用专用的GPU或主机模型,如何提供可预测的吞吐量,以及该方法可能失败的地方。
items.titleOriginal: Higgsfield - Building Agents That Provision Their Own Compute | DevDay 2026
items.descriptionOriginal: Explore how Higgsfield agents choose models and provision their own compute. Learn when to use dedicated GPUs or hosted models, how to deliver predictable throughput, and where the approach can fail.

items.title: OpenAI 如何将 ChatGPT 用于工作 ? @ DevDay 2026
items.description: 看看OpenAI的团队如何使用ChatGPT来管理发射,研究竞争对手,以及将专业知识转化为工具。 把实际想法带回自己的工作。
items.titleOriginal: How OpenAI Puts ChatGPT to Work | DevDay 2026
items.descriptionOriginal: See how OpenAI’s teams use ChatGPT to manage launches, research competitors, and turn expertise into tools. Take practical ideas back to your own work.

items.title: Codex 已经离开了笔记本电脑 2026 DevDay
items.description: 探索整个CLI、应用软件和网络中Codex的新内容。 通过现场演示,看看如何从授权单个任务转向让Codex解决所有问题和目标。
items.titleOriginal: Codex Has Left The Laptop | DevDay 2026
items.descriptionOriginal: Explore what’s new in Codex across the CLI, app, and web. Through live demos, see how to move from delegating individual tasks to letting Codex tackle entire problems and goals.

items.title: 从单玩家到多玩家 与 Codex QQ DevDay 2026
items.description: 跟踪从第一个Slack消息到一个被审查的修补的2m故障。 看看声音、 Appshots、插件和会议笔记如何帮助一个坚持不懈的个人特工调查并随时告知团队。
items.titleOriginal: From Single Player to Multiplayer with Codex | DevDay 2026
items.descriptionOriginal: Follow a 2am outage from the first Slack message to a reviewed fix. See how voice, Appshots, plugins, and meeting notes help a persistent personal agent investigate and keep the team informed.

items.title: Qodo - 《最后的人类法典评论:2026年DevDay》
items.description: 观察Qodo如何使用OpenAI来审查人工智能生成的代码。 探索一个挑战编码智能体假设和输出的对抗性审查器,并在模型信心仍然需要人类判断时学习。
items.titleOriginal: Qodo - The Last Human Code Review | DevDay 2026
items.descriptionOriginal: See how Qodo uses OpenAI to review AI-generated code. Explore an adversarial reviewer that challenges coding agents’ assumptions and output, and learn when model confidence still needs human judgment.
